🎗️Feedback from Our Lords: August 2026
Updates🎗️
🎗️Thanks for being an awesome part of our
community!
🎗️ Check Out the Full Details Here:
🎗️1. Increased the Decoration Level cap to Lv. 15.
New levels will unlock in the Cloudsea Odyssey
season. The Decoration Set Level cap has also been
increased to Lv. 10.
🎗️2. Added a Quick Challenge feature to PhantomPal
Rumble.
🎗️3. Optimized the Citadel Clash Inner City shortcut.
It will be hidden after the garrison and related events
are completed.
🎗️4. Optimized the counter animations in Adventure
and Expedition.
🎗️5. Horde, Nature, and League Ores can now be
exchanged for other resources.
🎗️6. The Mushroom Castle Design Manual has been
added to the Decor Rush Event.
🎗️7. Added a red dot notification to help prevent
Lords from missing the Citadel Clash Prediction.
🎗️8. Updated the Decor Store. The store can now be
refreshed to reveal more decors.
🎗️9. Optimized Bag item categories. Meteoric Iron
Core has been moved from the Item tab to the Shard
tab.
🎗️10. Guild Notice Improvements: Added Scheduled
Publishing, Like/Dislike Toggle, visibility limited to R4
& R5, as well as Star, Copy, and History features.
🎗️11. Added a lock feature for Captain-exclusive
rewards in the Treasure Carriage. 
🎗️12. Added a Decor attribute filter to help Lords
find Decor more easily. 
🎗️13. Optimized Garrison queue sorting in Citadel
Clash. You can now choose how many positions to
move a queue up or down. 
🎗️14. Added a second confirmation pop-up when
upgrading Castle Skin's star level for the first time
each day.
🎗️15. Added Behemoth and Heroic Spirit upgrade
material exchanges to the Trade Store.
🎗️16. The requirement for Pet Food Extract Weekly
Quests has been reduced to 20 times.
🎗️17. Castle Skin Optimization: Castle Skins
upgraded to 1 star (excluding Genesis) can now freely
switch between their 0-star and 1-star appearances.
🎗️18. Added Symbol of Heroes Decor exchange
items to the Star Gem Store in the Shadow of the
World Tree season and later seasons. Limited to 1
purchase per week.
